description:
## Why This Exists

post/smtp_relay.rs::find_header_end() is yet another copy of the header-end-finding logic, duplicating both injection.rs and post/mod.rs::find_header_boundary. Three copies of essentially the same byte-scanning function.

## Acceptance Criteria

Remove smtp_relay.rs::find_header_end and use crate::post::find_header_boundary instead.
title: Readability: smtp_relay.rs::find_header_end is a third copy of the same logic
